meta.title: Accessibility | Universidad Nacional de Concepción
meta.description: Accessibility declaration for the Universidad Nacional de Concepción portal.

hero.label: Digital inclusion
hero.title: Accessibility statement
hero.description: The Universidad Nacional de Concepción is committed to digital accessibility in accordance with MITIC standards and WCAG 2.1 Level AA.

features.title: Accessibility features
features.description: This portal includes the following tools to improve the experience for all users:

f1.title: Adjustable text size
f1.description: You can increase or decrease the text size of the portal using the accessibility panel located in the bottom corner of the screen.

f2.title: Contrast modes
f2.description: The portal offers high contrast and grayscale modes to improve readability for people with low vision or color blindness.

f3.title: Link underline
f3.description: You can enable underlines on all portal links to identify them more easily.

f4.title: Readable font
f4.description: Option to switch to a more readable typeface, especially useful for people with dyslexia.

f5.title: Keyboard navigation
f5.description: The entire portal is navigable by keyboard. Use Tab to move between elements and Enter to activate them.

f6.title: Responsive design
f6.description: The portal adapts to all screen sizes, from mobile devices to desktop monitors.

cta.title: Report an accessibility issue
cta.description: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this portal, please write to us at
cta.subject: with the subject "Accessibility". We are committed to responding within 5 business days.
